title: Four weekly lists of quiet estimates: how the pilot works
description:
What you send and what you get back: the four-week stale-estimate pilot, sales follow-up for contractors.

Stale Estimate Follow-Up List: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#contractors #salesfollowup

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/stale-estimate-follow-up?src=youtube&utm_campaign=stale-estimate-how-it-works
narration: Each week you send an export of your open estimates, plus anyone who asked not to be contacted.
You get every estimate quiet for seven days or more, grouped by age with the dollars waiting, a next step, and a draft follow-up.
Drafts never change your price or offer a discount, and you send them yourself.
Up to 200 open estimates, four weekly lists. The price and terms are on the page.
